title: Apple ASCwrap-v6 Mailbox MMIO & Framing Protocol Specification

INBOX_DATA_FIFO.description: FIFO data register for writing outgoing 64-bit command message words to SEP.

OUTBOX_DATA_FIFO.description: FIFO data register for reading incoming 64-bit reply message words from SEP.

COUNT.description: Number of available free words in inbox FIFO.

FULL.description: Asserted when inbox FIFO is completely full (64 words).

EMPTY.description: Asserted when inbox FIFO is completely drained.

COUNT.description: Number of readable response words in outbox FIFO.

FULL.description: Asserted when outbox FIFO is full.

EMPTY.description: Asserted when outbox FIFO contains zero messages.

DOORBELL_AP_TO_SEP.description: Triggers high-priority interrupt to SEP core indicating new message ready.

DOORBELL_SEP_TO_AP.description: Asserted by SEP upon response completion. Cleared by AP driver write.

INTERRUPT_ENABLE.description: Interrupt mask register enabling AIC IRQ assertion for FIFO state transitions.

lines.assertion: Triggered when Outbox FIFO count > 0; AP driver reads response packet.
Triggered when Inbox FIFO drains completely; unblocks pending message queue.
Doorbell synchronization interrupt signaling asynchronous event or state change.
Hardware exception interrupt signaling SEP panic, memory bus abort, or tamper attempt.

SEQUENCE_TAG.description: Correlation tag for asynchronous transaction tracking.

FLAGS.description: Message control flags (OOL payload, priority, reply expected).

header_format.word_1_to_7: Inline arguments (up to 48 bytes) for fast-path mailbox dispatch.

ool_descriptor.paddr_64: Physical DMA address mapped through DART-SEP Stream ID 0 (mapper-sep).
ool_descriptor.length_bytes: Buffer size in bytes (must be 16-byte aligned).

SEP_KEYSTORE.name: cmsgLOAD_KEYBAG
SEP_KEYSTORE.description: Loads user or system keybag into sepOS memory.

SEP_KEYSTORE.name: cmsgSAVE_KEYBAG
SEP_KEYSTORE.description: Exports sealed keybag encrypted under Device KEK.

SEP_KEYSTORE.name: cmsgUNWRAP_KEY
SEP_KEYSTORE.description: Unwraps per-file media key using specified protection class.

SEP_KEYSTORE.name: cmsgWRAP_KEY
SEP_KEYSTORE.description: Wraps new file media key under target protection class.

SEP_KEYSTORE.name: cmsgDROP_CLASS_KEYS
SEP_KEYSTORE.description: Evicts Class A keys immediately upon lock event (secret_drop).

SEP_KEYSTORE.name: cmsgVERIFY_PASSCODE
SEP_KEYSTORE.description: Verifies user passcode with scrypt hardware backoff.

SEP_ENTROPY.name: cmsgGET_ENTROPY_FOR_XNU_PRNG
SEP_ENTROPY.description: Transfers 64 bytes of high-entropy TRNG data to XNU kernel.

SEP_STORAGE.name: cmsgART_LOAD_TOKENS
SEP_STORAGE.description: Validates Anti-Replay Tokens during boot sequence.

SEP_STORAGE.name: cmsgART_COMMIT_TOKENS
SEP_STORAGE.description: Commits updated anti-replay state to persistent storage.
